title: B2 Milestone 4: Review Test
completion_message: ¡Brillante! Has superado el Cuarto Hito del Nivel B2. Tu dominio de estructuras complejas e idioma legal y tecnológico demuestra un altísimo nivel corporativo.

parts.visual:
En esta prueba repasaremos las lecciones 16 a 19 del nivel B2: 
- Advanced Relative Clauses (Whom, whose, omitting the pronoun). 
- Inverted Conditionals (Should you need, Were we to win, Had I known).
parts.audio: In this test we will review lessons 16 to 19 of the B2 level: Advanced Relative Clauses, and Inverted Conditionals.

parts.visual:
También evaluaremos tu vocabulario avanzado: 
- Tecnología e Innovación (Disruptive, scale up, algorithm). 
- Legal y Contratos (Loophole, liable, breach of contract, NDA). 
¡Demuestra que estás listo para la gerencia global!
parts.audio: We will also test your advanced vocabulary: Technology and Innovation, and Legal and Contracts. Show that you are ready for global management!

stages.title: Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Elige la respuesta correcta en este desafío integrador B2.

questions.question: The engineer ____ laptop was stolen reported it immediately. (Cuya).
The investors with ____ we met yesterday were impressed. (Con quienes).
The contract ____ I signed was legally binding. (Que - objeto).
questions.explanation: Se puede omitir (yo soy el sujeto, el contrato es el objeto).

questions.question: ____ you have any further questions, please contact me. (Si tienes - formal).
____ I known it was a scam, I wouldn't have invested. (Si hubiera sabido).
____ the server to fail, we have a backup system. (Si llegara a fallar - 2do condicional).
questions.explanation: Were the server to fail = If the server failed.

questions.question: Artificial Intelligence is a highly ____ technology. (Disruptiva).
We need more investment to ____ up our operations. (Escalar).
The company found a legal ____ to avoid paying taxes. (Vacío legal).
Because of the missing signature, the agreement is null and ____. (Nulo/Sin valor).
If we deliver late, we are ____ for damages. (Responsables legales).
We had to sign an ____ before seeing the new design. (Acuerdo de confidencialidad).
The new CEO caused a paradigm ____ in the corporate culture. (Cambio).
Our lawyers will ____ a new contract. (Redactar).
The two companies reached a ____ out of court. (Arreglo).
Anyone ____ knows the password must change it. (Que/Quien - sujeto).
questions.explanation: Who (es el sujeto del verbo knows).

questions.question: ____ we not invested, we would have gone bankrupt. (Si no hubiéramos).
questions.explanation: Had we not invested = If we hadn't invested.

questions.question: The person about ____ you spoke is my boss. (De quien).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave del nivel B2.

questions.question: ____ I known, I would go. (Si hubiera sabido)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración para tu examen final del bloque 4.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The manager whose office is here.
options: The manager whose office is here.
The manager who office is here.
The manager whom office is here.
The manager who's office is here.
questions.correct_answer: The manager whose office is here.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Should you need help, call me.
options: Should you need help, call me.
Would you need help, call me.
Could you need help, call me.
If you should need help, call me.
questions.correct_answer: Should you need help, call me.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: Had I known, I would have stayed.
options: Had I known, I would have stayed.
Have I known, I would have stayed.
Had I know, I would have stayed.
If I had known, I would have stayed.
questions.correct_answer: Had I known, I would have stayed.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: The contract is null and void.
options: The contract is null and void.
The contact is null and void.
The contract was null and void.
The contract is dull and void.
questions.correct_answer: The contract is null and void.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: It is a breach of contract.
options: It is a breach of contract.
It was a breach of contract.
Is it a breach of contract?
It is a break of contract.
questions.correct_answer: It is a breach of contract.
